method: Re-extracted all 65 changed records from checksum-verified cached PDFs, reproduced candidate text exactly, read old/candidate differences, inspected all 65 rendered closing boundary pages and checked eight missing footnote spans. Not an independent legal review or a full-page audit of every opinion.
limitations: Running headers and proof watermarks remain in raw extraction; they must not be treated as speaker evidence.
Footnotes are retained as source spans; continuations are not reordered into a polished reading edition.
No certification of majority support for every part or overall completeness of each opinion.
Only these 65 known boundary differences are repaired. Other records are unchanged.
The repaired file is a separate local source; serving artifacts and model inputs are not automatically rebuilt.
